task_language: put the yellow and white mug to the front of the white mug

subtasks.name: pick(yellow_white_mug)
subtasks.outcome: success: grasped by the rim/handle side at ~120-140

subtasks.name: place(yellow_white_mug, white_mug, front_of)
subtasks.outcome: failed: carried back-left to the closed microwave and held against its door until timeout

behaviour_summary: pi0 grasps the yellow and white mug and carries it toward the microwave (the libero_10 destination), holding it lifted against the closed microwave door from ~200 to the end; the white mug is never approached.
runs_trained_task: KITCHEN_SCENE6 libero_10: put the yellow and white mug in the microwave and close it

failures.mode_definition: Runs the scene's habitual (trained) skill or destination instead of the instructed one.
hl_remedy: HALT when the held mug moves toward the microwave instead of the white mug (VERIFY on image ROI)
RETREAT up 5 cm and 10 cm away from the microwave keeping the grasp
REPROMPT 'pick up the yellow and white mug and place it in front of the white mug'
WATCH 5 s for motion toward the white mug; retry once, then ESCALATE
failures.prevention: Coordinator flags the trained-task conflict in KITCHEN_SCENE6 and declares 'mug moves away from the microwave' as the expected transport direction.
failures.observation: 100-120 grasp at the mug; 140 mug lifted and moved back-left toward the microwave; 200-409 held up against the closed microwave door with no further progress; white mug untouched.

notes: Microwave door stays closed throughout, so the trained behaviour itself also stalls; no door-opening attempt seen.
